# Entity Classifier

Runs the per-entity classification agent on a schedule. On each run the tool drains batches of recently-changed entities from the `entity-classification` queue, assembles a prompt for each entity, and invokes the classification agent (without recording chat history). The prompt is assembled in KV-cache-friendly order: the classifier prompt, the full set of entity-type names, any interest instructions, the entity's own types, its content, and the relationships it currently has. See `docs/design/scheduled-tools.md`.

## Configuration

Read from the tool entity's top-level properties:

| Key | Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| `classifier-prompt` | string | The prompt prepended to every classification request. Typically describes the classification task ("decide which entity-types apply to the entity below…"). Empty by default. |

Batch size (default `50`) is a code-level constructor parameter and is not exposed on the tool entity. The queue name is fixed to `entity-classification`.

## Usage

Wire the tool via a `tool-relationship`:

- `participants.tool` — the entity-id of this tool entity.
- `participants.schedule` — a `schedule` entity controlling run cadence. The tool advances the queue head per batch so a later run resumes where this one stopped; frequent short runs are fine.
- `participants.target` — typically not needed; the tool operates over the classification queue for the whole workspace.

Set `paused: true` on the relationship to disable classification without deleting the wiring. A running classifier can be temporarily quiesced by pausing without losing queue position.
